The historic Christian Leinenweber House (built 1874), located at 3480 Franklin Avenue in Astoria, Oregon, United States, is listed on the US National Register of Historic Places.





This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 99000604 (Wikidata).
